open_points.subject: A10 rule 1 vs State 0 owner decision 18 (approval coverage)
open_points.text: State 0 decision 18: "Any difference at send ... asks again." A10 rule 1: on `request_digest` mismatch, the kernel proceeds "under a grant when one applies, otherwise by asking anew".
open_points.question: If an existing approval no longer matches the built request and a standing grant is active, must the kernel still ask again, or may it send under the grant?
options: Always ask again on any approval/request mismatch, even if a grant exists
Allow send under an active grant when approval mismatch occurs
open_points.default_guess: Allow send under grant (follow A10 rule 1 literal flow).

open_points.subject: Mapped node `map_over` input cardinality constraint
open_points.text: A05 phase 5 defines feed rules and says "A node with `map_over` has exactly one input fed that way", but does not explicitly require that `map_over` names a `one` input port; M14/A13 semantics assume element-wise calls.
open_points.question: Must a `map_over` port itself be cardinality `one` (receiving each element), or can it be `many`?
options: Allow `map_over` on `many` and define per-element value as list element (possibly nested lists)
open_points.default_guess: Refuse `map_over` unless the mapped input port cardinality is `one`.

open_points.subject: A13 run response shape while run is resting
open_points.text: A13 rule 7 says "A run that rests returns the outputs produced so far; the per-output reasons below are given only once it has ended" and also "The run's answer names every flow output port with either its value or a reason".
open_points.question: For `running`/`awaiting_approval`/`pending` runs, must the response include all flow outputs (with a placeholder/reason), or only currently produced outputs?
options: Return only produced outputs until run ends
Always return every flow output with explicit per-port state, even before end
open_points.default_guess: Return only produced outputs before end; include full per-output reasons only at end.

open_points.subject: A16 pagination token semantics for mutable entities
open_points.text: A16 rule 6: "Items come newest first, in reverse store order ... continuation token is the store position of the last item returned." Models like M11/M24/M25 have in-place lifecycle state changes (`proposed`→`accepted`, `requested`→`approved`/`used`, `active`→`revoked`).
open_points.question: When an entity changes status, does its list order position change (treated as 'newest') or stay at original creation position?
options: Ordering is by creation position only; state updates do not move item
Ordering is by latest mutation position; updates move item to newest
open_points.default_guess: Keep creation position ordering; status updates do not change pagination order.
